statement: No remaining demonstrated source or qualification blocker within tested scope.
reviewMethod: Independent read-only diff, import-map, qualification runner and final active-scene artifact review. Did not repeat the browser qualification.
sourceFindings: Surface output, current-state admission and evaluation enforce local support plus 2.25m within 1e-8m; distant lookahead and yaw do not determine height.
The local geometric guard rejects obstruction rather than lifting camera height.
Surface sweep now bounds ascent and descent by 1.0m per horizontal meter plus 0.04m per sampled segment; interior or portal segments retain 0.65m/m plus 0.04m.
Cavern layer persistence, real emitted support geometry and portal-only transition logic remain unchanged.
All observed navigation import aliases converge to the exact reviewed source blob.
limitations: The 24 long-route cases comprise 18 complete routes, three hill-up collision stops near z=-207.9 and three invalid reverse seeds at z=-220; they are not 24 complete traversals.
The added slope rule is a sampled traversal policy, not full collision physics. Its fixed 0.04m per-segment allowance can produce timestep-dependent eligibility near sharp physical seams.
Four jamb seeds remained ineligible, so accepted near-jamb transitions were not exercised.
Already detached or lifted predecessor states are rejected except RESET; normal new states initialize against the new local support rule.
Headless desktop software WebGL does not establish physical-device performance or perceptual acceptance.
No exhaustive collision certification, exact owner-footage route reproduction, or live publication completion is asserted by this review.
